svg.title: From any sound to a note
svg.desc: Five sources take turns: a video call, a podcast app, a video in the browser, the room and a file. As each plays, its sound flows into Splashdown and becomes a note line by line, with time stamps, a summary or action items, and tags: the call becomes a meeting note with You and Them, the podcast and the video become transcripts, the lecture is recorded from the microphone, and an interview file is transcribed.

g.text: Them Can we cut the pricing table?
You Yes, three rows is plenty.
Them I'll model the annual plan.
Short sentences are easier to hear.
Read it aloud before you publish.
• Write the way you'd say it
This part is on the exam.
A call becomes a meeting note, with its action items
A podcast becomes a transcript you can search
A video in your browser, written down as it plays
A lecture in the room, from the microphone
A voice memo or a link, dropped onto Notes
